method.momentum: Relative rate ratio: topic growth (last 4 wks vs prior 8) divided by the growth of all other tracked topics. Cancels the news index's recency bias. 1.0 = growing in line with the basket.
method.p_momentum: Exact conditional binomial test: is the topic's recent fraction of articles different from the basket's recent fraction? (H0: no relative shift)
method.trend: Mann-Kendall monotonic trend test on the weekly share of voice; Sen's slope = robust share change (percentage points per week).
method.breadth: Distinct outlets publishing on the topic in last 4 weeks.
method.exposure: BMW domain complaints x avg severity (from bmw_ev_technology_domain_summary.csv), normalised 0-1.
method.priority: 100 x (0.35 attention percentile + 0.35 momentum percentile + 0.30 BMW exposure).
method.signal: Accelerating: momentum >= 1.25 and p < 0.05; Cooling: momentum <= 0.8 and p < 0.05; else Stable.
method.quota_resolution: Adaptive multi-tier domain & keyword partitioning: when peak news days hit the Google News 100-item query quota, queries are dynamically partitioned across 5 media cohorts (Sina, Sohu, Auto specialists, Financial press, Remainder) and sub-split to recover the full census without truncation.
